```yaml
name: Lint and Type Check

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  lint-and-typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22.x
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: make eslint

      - name: Run Prettier
        run: make format

      - name: Run TypeScript compiler
        run: make tsc

      - name: Run Publish Check
        run: make publish-dry-run
```
